reasons: Cited text supports the compliant claim: 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor with notice only, matching the preferred position.

24.2 restricts Vendor assignment (including by change of control and delegation of material performance) to consented assignees under a reasonableness standard and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor.
24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, re-pricing, fee-acceleration, or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control, so no walk-away trigger exists.
24.3 is limited to 'other assignments' and is mutual with a not-unreasonably-withheld standard, so it does not undercut the 24.1 carve-out; 13.3 aligns licence transfer with permitted assignments.
No redline or comment is expected for a compliant finding, and the deterministic check confirms the successor/affiliate carve-out is present.
